## The Julia version is better. How do I move people?

- In my view the Julia one is clearly better. Any distribution, one
  implementation, and the type carries the model
- It is also the one nobody uses, and I would still point an R user at
  `primarycensored` today
- Rewriting the R stack in Julia is not the answer, and neither is
  waiting for people to arrive

::: {.callout-important}
So how do I get people to shift?
:::
